agencies_paid_to.name: agencies_paid_to
agencies_paid_to.value: ("agencies"."commission_paid_to" IS NULL OR "agencies"."commission_paid_to" IN ('agencia', 'subagencia', 'agente')) AND ("agencies"."bonus_paid_to" IS NULL OR "agencies"."bonus_paid_to" IN ('agencia', 'subagencia', 'agente'))

agencies_payment_code_compania.name: agencies_payment_code_compania
agencies_payment_code_compania.value: ("agencies"."payment_code_claro" IS NULL OR 'claro' = ANY("agencies"."internal_companies")) AND ("agencies"."payment_code_atoz" IS NULL OR 'atoz' = ANY("agencies"."internal_companies"))

agents_payment_code_compania.name: agents_payment_code_compania
agents_payment_code_compania.value: ("agents"."payment_code_claro" IS NULL OR 'claro' = ANY("agents"."internal_companies")) AND ("agents"."payment_code_atoz" IS NULL OR 'atoz' = ANY("agents"."internal_companies"))

discount_sellers_payment_code.name: discount_sellers_payment_code
discount_sellers_payment_code.value: ("discount_sellers"."agent_id" IS NULL OR ("discount_sellers"."payment_code_claro" IS NULL AND "discount_sellers"."payment_code_atoz" IS NULL)) AND ("discount_sellers"."payment_code_claro" IS NULL OR 'claro' = ANY("discount_sellers"."internal_companies")) AND ("discount_sellers"."payment_code_atoz" IS NULL OR 'atoz' = ANY("discount_sellers"."internal_companies"))
